name: Do I need a built-in shower seat, fold-down seat, or movable bench?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a built-in shower seat, fold-down seat, or movable bench?

acceptedAnswer.text: A shower seat is often useful when standing tolerance, balance, fatigue, or caregiver assistance makes bathing difficult, but its size and position must match the user and shower layout. Elite Remodeling & Design can coordinate a built-in or fold-down seat with controls, handheld spray, shelves, bars, and drainage. Context: A seat can improve stability but may reduce clear floor area when unfolded or complicate cleaning if placed poorly. Key factors: transfer direction, seat height, depth, weight support, caregiver access, control reach, and fold-up clearance. Practical guidance: Decide whether the seat should be permanent, fold-down, or movable before selecting the shower system. Mark the intended seat position and confirm the user can reach controls without twisting. Include blocking and waterproofing details in the construction scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: A permanent seat suits consistent seated bathing, a fold-down seat preserves more open floor area, and a movable bench offers flexibility but may shift or obstruct movement. Choose based on transfers, caregiver access, control reach, shower size, cleaning, and required wall support.
